description: Update a deficiency (write — editor). Only passed fields change. Completing needs a retest_note. There is no delete: set status cancelled instead.

description.description: New description, or null to clear

due_date.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null to clear

owner_name.description: Free-text owner, or null to clear

owner_user_id.description: Owner user (must be an org member, 404 otherwise), or null to clear

priority.description: Priority: critical, high, medium, low (cannot be cleared)

retest_note.description: What was retested and the result. Required to complete. Ignored when reopening: a reopened deficiency starts without one

root_cause.description: Why it arose; null or blank clears it

status.description: Status: open, in_progress, completed, cancelled (cannot be cleared). Moving to completed needs retest_note (422 otherwise). Restoring a cancelled capability-test finding is refused while that test is recorded as passed

name: scf_update_deficiency
